result:
I'd make curiosity the dominant human drive—stronger than fear, tribalism, or short-term comfort. 

Give every person an unbreakable habit of asking "what is actually true?" and the tools to chase the answer without punishment or distraction. Most of the world's ugliest problems (war, poverty traps, bad policy, preventable suffering) shrink fast once enough people stop defending comforting lies. The rest of progress would take care of itself.
